title: "He is going through hell": Trump says Jensen Huang is distressed over impact of controversy on wife, family
summary: "I spoke to him yesterday. He's going through hell. What he feels most badly about is his wife and family. That's what he is really, that's what he told me. And in, strongest, he called me as the president. I'm president, and he called me. And he said, what I've done to my wife and family is, that's what he talked about," Trump said.
llm_summary: Former President Donald Trump said he recently spoke with NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, describing Huang as “going through hell” because of the backlash surrounding a controversy that has affected his wife and family.
